US Supreme Court Hands Down Landmark Decision on Presidential Power

The US Supreme Court has issued a ruling that grants President Donald Trump significant control over key aspects of the government. This decision has sparked reactions from various quarters, with some hailing it as a victory for the president and others criticizing its implications. The ruling is seen as a major development in the ongoing debate about presidential power and its limits.
